_meta._comment: Actions that resolve one character's check against other characters, for Mutants & Masterminds 4e (Open Game Content). Numeric game-mechanical facts and short paraphrased labels only. Consumed by mm_companion.core.data_loader; core.rules.impress and core.rules.targeting interpret these generically rather than hardcoding the action in Python.
_meta.impressNote: The Impress action. An interaction skill check sets the DC each target resists; the degree by which a target fails picks a rung of the chosen impression's ladder.
_meta.skillsNote: Skill ids (skills.json) an impression may be made with. Any impression pairs with any of them: the impression decides what success does, the skill decides what is rolled.
_meta.resistNote: What a target resists with. sameSkill offers the skill the impresser used; skills and resistances name further options by id. 'Use highest' picks the best of them on the target's own sheet.
_meta.groupPenaltyNote: Applied once to the impress check when it is aimed at more than one target (a group impression).
_meta.impressionsNote: Each impression: an id, a display name, an optional suggested skill (preselected when it is chosen), an optional advantage id the impresser must have, and an outcomes ladder in the same shape as an effect's resistanceOutcomes (one rung per degree of failure, the last covering every deeper one). A rung's parameters map a condition id to the parameter it is applied with; '{source}' is replaced by the impresser's name.
_meta.modifiersNote: The situational modifiers the GM sets on an impress check. kind 'toggle' is a checkbox worth value; toggles sharing an exclusive group cannot both be on. kind 'slider' runs from min to max in steps of step and is worth its position.
_meta.provenance: Impress action, impression effects and impress check modifiers: Mutants & Masterminds core rules, Action and Adventure chapter. Mechanics only; labels paraphrased.
